dimensions.assessment: Affects critical infrastructure operators, digital infrastructure providers, research institutions, and entities at high risk of quantum cyberattacks.
dimensions.evidence: entities that are high risk of quantum cryptoanalytic attacks, such as entities determined to be critical infrastructure

dimensions.assessment: Provides guidance, technical assistance, and potential grant funding to help organizations adopt new cryptographic standards.
dimensions.evidence: provision of technical assistance through the award of grants to entities that are at high risk

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a grant program subject to the availability of appropriations, but specifies no dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations... the Director may establish a program to identify and provide technical assistance through the award of grants

dimensions.assessment: Amends the National Quantum Initiative Act and the Cyber Security Research and Development Act to expand NIST and NSF programs.
dimensions.evidence: amend the National Quantum Initiative Act and the Cyber Security Research and Development Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent programmatic authorities for federal cryptography standards promotion and research support.

missing_information: Specific authorized funding levels or appropriation caps for the grant program
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the National Quantum Initiative Act and Cyber Security Research and Development Act to promote voluntary deployment of post-quantum cryptography standards, authorize technical assistance grants for high-risk entities, and support cryptography research.
